parts.label: Battery 12V (Front Trunk)
parts.function: Group-48 / H6 12 V battery under the front luggage-compartment floor panel, supplying all vehicle electrical systems and engine start. Use a memory saver before disconnecting; negative off first, positive on first; re-register if switching to AGM.

parts.label: Alternator
parts.function: Belt-driven generator on the mid-mounted flat-six charging the battery and powering the 12 V system while the engine runs; on the 987.2 it hangs on the 9A1's single accessory belt alongside the external coolant pump and the power-steering pump.

parts.label: Starter Motor
parts.function: Electric motor low on the bellhousing that cranks the flat-six during start; engages the flywheel ring gear via a solenoid-actuated pinion. Long positive cable run from the frunk battery to the rear engine bay.

parts.label: Fuse Panel / Relay Carrier
parts.function: Main fuse panel behind the driver-side footwell / dash end panel housing blade fuses and relay carriers that protect and route the primary electrical circuits — the first stop for any dead-circuit diagnosis on a 987.

parts.label: PSM Control Unit (Stability Management)
parts.function: Porsche Stability Management control unit processing wheel-speed, yaw and lateral-acceleration signals to command ABS, ABD, ASR, MSR and EBD interventions; standard on all 987s, with brake pre-filling, brake assist and drive-off assistant added for the 987.2 (2009 Service Introduction).

parts.label: Front Body Control Module
parts.function: Front body control electronics governing exterior lighting, horn, rain/light sensor integration and comfort functions on the 987's CAN network.

parts.label: Instrument Cluster / Combi-Instrument
parts.function: Central driver display combining the analogue centre rev-counter with speedometer, fuel/temperature gauges, warning indicators and the on-board computer; also hosts the TPM tire-pressure warnings on the 987.2.

parts.label: Sport Chrono Module
parts.function: Control unit of the optional Sport Chrono Package (Plus) managing the sharper engine map, PASM and PSM thresholds in Sport mode, and driving the dash-top analogue/digital stopwatch for lap timing.

parts.label: Sport / Sport Plus Button
parts.function: Centre-console SPORT button (SPORT PLUS with Sport Chrono Package Plus and PDK on the 987.2) requesting the dynamic engine, PASM damping and shift maps; also relaxes PSM brake-assist thresholds for sporty driving.

parts.label: Cabin Particle / Pollen Filter
parts.function: Particle filter in the heater/air-conditioning intake behind the front-compartment firewall trim, cleaning cabin air before the blower. A clogged element is the number-one cause of weak airflow and musty A/C on a 987 — replaced at every minor service.
